creatorEvents.name: Frostfang Village: The Pack Survives

vnPages.scene: Snow lashes across a frozen training yard.
vnPages.title: The Pack Survives
vnPages.speaker: Elder Sova
dialogue: Elder Sova: The ice remembers footsteps. Walk with purpose, and it carries you.
Elder Sova: I am Elder Sova.
Elder Sova: It is my honor to meet someone chosen by the Frost Echo.

vnPages.scene: Snow lashes across a frozen training yard.
vnPages.title: The Warning
vnPages.speaker: Captain Yura
dialogue: Captain Yura: No shinobi stands alone. Your village gives your hands meaning.
Captain Yura: I am Yura and I will always have your back.
Captain Yura: The Frost Echo has not chosen someone for generations.

vnPages.scene: Snow lashes across a frozen training yard.
vnPages.title: The Kage's Shadow
vnPages.speaker: Frost Seal Echo
dialogue: Frost Seal Echo: Protect yourself, but think like part of a formation.
Frost Seal Echo: The pact was made to protect us.
Frost Seal Echo: Now prove your village deserves another future.

creatorEvents.vnScene: Snow lashes across a frozen training yard.

vnPages.scene: An ancient energy stirs as you step beyond the village gates.
vnPages.title: A Strange Resonance
vnPages.speaker: Narrator
dialogue: Narrator: The moment you step past the gates, a deep hum resonates through your chakra network.
Narrator: It pulses from far away — from the heart of Central, the Thousand Gates.
Village Elder: Wait, young one. You feel it, don't you?
Village Elder: That vibration. The Awakening Stone is calling to you.
Village Elder: Hidden within Central Hub lies an ancient relic — the Awakening Stone.
Village Elder: Every shinobi carries a hidden elemental nature — Water, Wind, Earth, Lightning, or Fire.
Village Elder: The stone will awaken yours and align your chakra to its truest form.
Village Elder: Travel to Central Hub. Find the Awakening Stone. Discover your element.
Village Elder: At certain power thresholds — level 2 and level 20 — the stone will read you for free.
Narrator: A new path opens before you. The Awakening Stone awaits in Central...

creatorEvents.name: Ryo
creatorEvents.vnScene: Rain taps against the village rooftops while an unknown shinobi waits beneath the lanterns.
dialogue: A strange chakra pressure fills the air.
Admin Event: Test your strength, shinobi.

petEncounterVn.name: Pet Encounter

vnPages.scene: The rustling of leaves breaks the silence of the sector.
vnPages.title: A Presence in the Shadows
vnPages.speaker: Narrator
dialogue: Narrator: Something stirs at the edge of your senses.
Narrator: A warmth — not from fire, but from living breath nearby.
Narrator: You stop moving. So does it.

vnPages.scene: A creature emerges from the undergrowth, watching you carefully.
vnPages.title: The Creature Reveals Itself
vnPages.speaker: Narrator
dialogue: Narrator: Eyes catch yours — ancient, curious, unafraid.
Narrator: It does not run. It does not attack.
Narrator: It simply waits.

vnPages.scene: The creature tilts its head as if asking a question only it understands.
vnPages.title: A Choice Before You
vnPages.speaker: Narrator
dialogue: Narrator: Shinobi learn to read animals the way they read the wind.
Narrator: This one is not lost. It chose to find you.
Narrator: The question is — will you let it stay?

petEncounterVn.vnScene: The rustling of leaves breaks the silence of the sector.

ancientChestVn.name: Ancient Chest

vnPages.scene: Deep within the wilderness, a faint shimmer catches your eye.
vnPages.title: Something Stirs in the Ruins
vnPages.speaker: Narrator
dialogue: Narrator: You pause. Something between the rubble is glowing.
Narrator: Half-buried under centuries of earth and stone — an ancient chest.
Narrator: These runes... pre-war era seals. This thing has been here a long time.
Narrator: The chakra lock flickers as you approach, as if recognizing your presence.
Narrator: Whoever left this... they wanted someone strong enough to find it.
Narrator: You press your hand to the seal. It dissolves at your touch.

vnPages.scene: Golden light spills from the ancient chest as the seal breaks.
vnPages.title: The Chest Opens
vnPages.speaker: Narrator
dialogue: Narrator: The lid swings open with a low resonant hum.
Narrator: Inside — preserved by chakra for decades — the chest reveals its contents.
Narrator: ...I wasn't expecting this.
Narrator: The ancient shinobi who sealed this chest left something worth finding.
